column3: >Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

>Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

column1: As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in France: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings.
This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely.
• You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.
• You're excited by AI: you'll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space.
• You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make.

• You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically.
• You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust.
• You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before.

• Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value.
<li>Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&amp
column2: S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice.

column1: • Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost.
• Write personalised, researched outreach (including cold emails) that carries a specific point of view into every call, rather than working from a generic script.

• Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to.
• Keep meticulous account and contact records in Salesforce.
• Become a product expert and represent the Samsara brand at trade shows and events.
• 1–3 years professional experience, ideally in customer-facing roles

column1: • Highly motivated and committed, with a strong desire to work in target-driven sales
• Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding targets in previous roles
• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
• Curious, and able to ask insightful questions
• Highly proficient in English and fluent in French
• AI literacy and ability to showcase examples of leveraging AI in your work
• Comfort turning unstructured information (an annual report, a website, a news article) into a clear commercial argument
• Experience multi-threading or navigating multiple stakeholders within a single sale
• A genuine willingness to prepare — to research and write — before a call, rather than relying on improvising well under pressure
<li>Experience in closing-sales roles or similar target driven environment&nbsp
• A proven track record of achievement beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity)
• Willingness to collaborate and influence in a ""win as a team"" environment
• Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways
• Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space.

Through Samsara's ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility. With emphasis on continued professional development, training doesn't stop after onboarding — we provide opportunities to expand ADRs' understanding of the market and competitors, develop hard skills, and work with mentors to progress through three levels:

• ADR I — focus on inbound leads: a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with interested prospects. Learning opportunities include call sessions with senior Sales team members, tool training (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, and objection handling.

• ADR II — work on top-of-funnel movement, creating high-quality sales engagements, and supporting Account Executives. Enrolled in specialised training including professional writing, persona-based messaging, cold calling 2.0, and AE collaboration.

• ADR III — work hand-in-hand with field Account Executives and Enterprise Regional Sales Managers. Partner on large accounts, implement territory plans, join weekly strategy meetings, and schedule/attend customer demos, alongside a mentorship program ahead of an AE interview.

Please submit an English CV with your application.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

column1: Chez Green-Got, le Customer Care est la voix de nos membres en interne, et la voix de Green-Got auprès d'eux, un rôle stratégique dans une institution financière qui grandit vite et qui doit tenir ses promesses 7 jours sur 7.

Nos membres ont changé de dimension avec nous : Compte Premium, PER, compte commun, offre indépendant. Chaque nouveau produit génère de nouvelles questions, de nouvelles situations, de nouveaux défis. L'ouverture prochaine des services BtoB va encore élargir le périmètre.
Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui aime comprendre, qui sait garder son calme sous pression, et qui considère chaque échange comme une opportunité d'améliorer le produit, pas juste de fermer un ticket.
Tu es à l'aise avec les gens et rigoureux sur le fond. Les deux à la fois.

Membre de l'équipe Customer Care, tu es le point de relais central entre nos membres et toutes les équipes de Green-Got : produit, tech, compliance, marketing, impact. Ton périmètre est vivant : il évolue avec nos lancements, nos besoins, et la trajectoire de Green-Got.
Ta capacité à t'adapter, à prioriser et à garder un haut niveau de qualité dans tous les contextes est ce qui nous permettra de grandir sereinement.
• Premier point de contact : tu réponds à nos membres sur tous nos canaux, chat (90 %), email (8 %), téléphone (2 %), avec clarté, empathie et dans les délais.

• Expertise produit : tu connais Green-Got sur le bout des doigts. Tu accompagnes nos membres sur leurs comptes, leurs transactions, leurs questions, et tu trouves la bonne réponse après investigation.
• Gestion des nouvelles situations : tu identifies, qualifies et résous les cas inédits. Tu es garant de la qualité du premier contact.
• Voix des membres en interne : tu collectes, structures et remontes les besoins, frustrations et suggestions aux équipes produit, tech, marketing.
• Amélioration continue : tu optimises les process existants, challenges les workflows, et maintiens notre documentation (FAQ, process) à jour à chaque évolution produit.
• Suivi des incidents : tu identifies les bugs, les remontes aux équipes concernées et en assures le suivi jusqu'à résolution.
• Recette fonctionnelle : tu participes aux phases de test des nouvelles fonctionnalités avant mise en production.
• Initiative et ownership : tu identifies des leviers d'amélioration de l'expérience membre, tu définis des indicateurs, proposes et mets en œuvre des actions concrètes.
• Pilotage : tu mets en place les outils et routines nécessaires au suivi de tes projets et en garantis le résultat.

L'empathie, la rigueur dans l'exécution et la capacité à rester serein quand ça s'accélère sont pour toi des réflexes naturels. Tu comprends que la qualité du service est un engagement, pas une intention. Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui en est convaincu.
Chez Green-Got, nous sommes curieux, exigeants, collectifs, et nous allons vite.
• Sens du service : tu sais que derrière chaque ticket, il y a une personne. Tu ne fermes pas un ticket, tu résous un problème.
• Rigueur et organisation : tu priorises, tu documentes, tu assures un suivi sans failles.
• Aisance rédactionnelle : ton orthographe est irréprochable, tu adaptes le ton à chaque interlocuteur. La précision est ta signature.
• Curiosité analytique : tu aimes comprendre pourquoi une situation se produit, pas juste la résoudre. Tu identifies les patterns et tu les remontes.
• Gestion du stress : tu gardes ton calme quand la situation l'exige. La pression ne dégrade pas ta qualité.
• Anglais opérationnel : tu lis, tu réponds, tu échanges sans chercher tes mots. Nous avons des membres non francophones et nous en aurons davantage.
• Sensibilité à l'impact : la transition environnementale a une réelle importance pour toi. Tu comprends les enjeux et tu portes la mission de Green-Got avec sincérité.
• Appétence pour les outils numériques : Intercom, Notion, Slack, Aircall, et une vraie curiosité pour l'IA et l'automatisation appliquées au service client.
• Formation : BTS, IUT, école de commerce, IAE ou toute formation en lien avec la relation client. Une première expérience en care ou service client est un vrai plus.
Green-Got entre dans une nouvelle phase. Avec l'agrément ACPR, nous construisons une expérience membre de premier plan, avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant.
Le service client de demain ne se construit uniquement avec des scripts et des macros. Il se construit avec des personnes qui comprennent le produit, les membres, et l'enjeu de chaque interaction.
• Un rôle avec de l'impact réel : dans un secteur en pleine transformation, au contact direct de nos membres chaque jour.
• De vraies responsabilités : tu n'exécutes pas, tu contribues. Tes remontées terrain façonnent le produit.
• Apprentissage : aux côtés d'une équipe qui transmet, dans un environnement réglementaire de premier plan.
• Évolution : les profils les plus engagés grandissent avec nous et prennent des responsabilités clés.
• Flexibilité : remote possible depuis chez toi et partout en Europe.
• Équipe : ambitieuse, exigeante, déterminée, et qui passe de bons moments ensemble.
• Envoie-nous ton CV et tout autre élément qui nous aide à jauger tes compétences et ta motivation.
• Call rapide pour faire connaissance. Si ça matche, on t’envoie un Business Case à préparer.
• Entretien en visio avec Vincent (Customer Care Manager) pour analyser le Business Case et te tester / te connaitre.
• Échange avec un ou plusieurs membres de l’équipe pour le fit culturel.

Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer !

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🦾 Our Offer Operations team

Joko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. Behind each of these experiences, there's an operational engine that needs to work flawlessly: transactions must be tracked, cashback must be caught, offers must be reliable, and merchants must perform as expected. When this engine breaks, users don't get paid — and trust erodes fast.

Offer Operations owns that engine. The team's mission is to guarantee the reliability and continuous improvement of Joko's core monetization mechanics — across affiliate tracking, coupons, card-linked bank integrations, gift cards, and merchant performance. It's a technical, data-heavy, high-stakes scope that sits right at the heart of what makes Joko's product work.

🎯 What you will do

As an Operations Manager, your main mission is to own one of the processes that decides whether millions of Joko users actually get the cashback they're owed. You'll report to David Le Pahun, our Offer Operations Lead. The role blends four things: analysing data, designing how the process should work, solving problems with AI, technologies or in the last resort outsourcing, and managing projects.

  • Analyse data. You'll build the dashboards that tell you — and everyone else — whether your part of the system is healthy: how many transactions are being correctly tracked and rewarded, what's silently breaking down, whether user experience is suffering.

  • Design the process. You decide how merchants get set up on our platform: their cashback rate, which purchases qualify, how we connect to their systems. A lot of this doesn't have a playbook yet — you'll be writing a good chunk of it as you go.

  • Solve problems with technology. A merchant might be showing users a coupon that doesn't actually pay out. A batch of card purchases might not match cleanly to any merchant we track. You'll dig into why, then fix it choosing the right solution for it: automating it with AI, improving one of our internal tools (built on Retool) and if a human is required, you'll build the right playbook to outsource it.

  • Manage outsourced resources. You'll manage the outsourced team members who help you operate at scale — briefing them, training them, checking their work is actually good — while juggling several of these issues at once and deciding what matters most.

Vos missions

1.Gestion des appels et suivi des transports

  • Écouter les demandes, recueillir les informations et apporter une réponse adaptée.

  • Accompagner les conducteurs par téléphone tout au long de leur service.

  • Suivre les tournées et vérifier que les transports se déroulent correctement.

  • Modifier les tournées et répartir les courses si nécessaire.

  • Informer les usagers en cas de retard ou de changement.

  • Assurer une permanence téléphonique de 10h à 19h , selon l'organisation du service.

2. Assistance aux conducteurs

  • Répondre aux questions et aux demandes des conducteurs.

  • Leur transmettre les changements d'horaires, de trajets ou de prises en charge.

  • Organiser les remplacements en cas d'absence.

  • Vérifier les prises et les fins de service.

  • Faire le lien entre les conducteurs et le service Exploitation.

  • Veiller au respect des consignes et des règles concernant les temps de conduite, de travail et de repos.

3. Gestion des réservations

  • Enregistrer les demandes de transport.

  • Vérifier et valider les réservations selon les règles du service.

  • Ajouter les nouvelles demandes aux tournées.

  • Prendre en compte les annulations et les changements de dernière minute.

  • Adapter les horaires et les trajets pour organiser au mieux les transports.

  • Vérifier que les informations sont correctement enregistrées dans les outils de travail.

4. Relation avec les usagers et les clients

  • Répondre aux demandes par téléphone avec courtoisie et professionnalisme.

  • Informer les usagers en cas de retard, de changement ou de difficulté.

  • Traiter les demandes courantes et les réclamations simples.

  • Transmettre les situations particulières au responsable.

  • Noter et suivre les réclamations et les événements importants.

5. Suivi des incidents

  • Appliquer les consignes prévues en cas d'incident.

  • Évaluer la situation et contacter les secours si nécessaire.

  • Prévenir rapidement le responsable.

  • Suivre l'incident jusqu'à sa résolution.

  • Rédiger un compte rendu et conserver les informations nécessaires au suivi.

6. Gestion du stock de téléphones professionnels

  • Suivre le stock de téléphones de l'entreprise.

  • Réceptionner et enregistrer les nouveaux appareils.

  • Identifier chaque téléphone grâce à son numéro de ligne, son numéro de série et son IMEI.

  • Tenir à jour un tableau indiquant les téléphones disponibles, attribués, en panne, en réparation ou hors service.

  • Préparer les téléphones avant leur remise aux salariés et aux conducteurs.

  • Prévoir des téléphones de remplacement.

  • Anticiper les besoins lors des nouvelles embauches ou des changements de poste.

Profil recherché

  • Vous avez une formation en gestion, administration, transport ou organisation.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise au téléphone et vous vous exprimez clairement.

  • Vous aimez le contact avec les autres et savez répondre avec calme et courtoisie.

  • Vous savez gérer plusieurs demandes en même temps et garder votre calme en cas d'urgence.

  • Vous êtes organisé(e), sérieux(se), réactif(ve) et savez prendre des initiatives.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec l'informatique et les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel.

  • Vous apprenez facilement à utiliser de nouveaux logiciels et outils numériques.

  • Vous aimez travailler en équipe et communiquer avec différents interlocuteurs.

Une première expérience dans le transport, la régulation, la gestion des appels ou un service d'exploitation serait appréciée.

Les qualités importantes pour ce poste : le sens du contact, une bonne élocution, la réactivité, l'organisation, la patience et le sérieux.

Basé(e) à Paris, vous participerez au développement de la visibilité digitale de notre activité au Royaume-Uni, et plus particulièrement de notre établissement londonien, l'un des plus importants du réseau.

  • Participer à la définition et au déploiement de la stratégie social media pour le marché britannique.

  • Concevoir et produire des contenus engageants adaptés aux différentes plateformes (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube).

  • Réaliser des photos, vidéos, Reels, Stories et autres formats créatifs.

  • Élaborer et suivre le calendrier éditorial.

  • Assurer la publication et l'animation quotidienne des réseaux sociaux.

  • Interagir avec les communautés et contribuer au développement de l'engagement.

  • Analyser les performances des contenus et des campagnes (reporting, KPIs, recommandations).

  • Effectuer une veille régulière sur les tendances digitales, les nouveautés des plateformes et les bonnes pratiques du secteur.

Vos compétences

  • Étudiant(e) en communication, marketing digital, école de commerce ou formation équivalente (Bac +4 / Bac +5).

  • Excellente maîtrise de l'anglais à l'écrit comme à l'oral (niveau C1/C2 indispensable).

  • Bonne connaissance des principaux réseaux sociaux et de leurs codes.

  • À l'aise avec les outils de création de contenus (Canva, CapCut, Adobe Express, suite Adobe ou équivalent).

  • Intérêt marqué pour la création de contenus photo et vidéo.

  • Créatif(ve), autonome, organisé(e) et force de proposition.

  • Sensibilité aux tendances digitales et curiosité pour les nouveaux formats de communication.

Une première expérience en gestion de réseaux sociaux ou création de contenus serait appréciée.

  • Type de contrat : stage de 6 mois

About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Dust is looking for a Product Marketer to shape how we bring a fast-moving, technical product to market and build the engine behind our product launches.

You will lead product launches and storytelling at Dust, turning a constant stream of product innovation into clear positioning, compelling narratives, and launches that help customers understand what’s new, why it matters, and what they can do with it.

This is a hands-on role. You will work closely with product and engineering to understand what we’re building, find the story within it, and bring that story to life across messaging, web, video, social, customer communications, and sales enablement. You’ll own the work from strategy through execution, bringing in designers, contractors, and other partners where they can add specialist expertise.

It’s a rare opportunity to help define the product narrative of a category-defining AI company while the product, the market, and the way people work with AI are all evolving quickly.

What you'll do

Own Dust’s product launch motion

  • Own product launches from initial narrative and positioning through asset creation, amplification strategy, and sales enablement

  • Build and run an always-on launch program that keeps pace with Dust’s rapid product development, supporting at least 5-7 releases each quarter

  • Partner closely with engineering team to understand what’s shipping, why it matters, and which initiatives require a broader market moment

  • Establish lightweight launch tiers and processes that bring consistency without slowing the team down

Turn product innovation into compelling stories

  • Develop positioning and messaging for new capabilities, translating technical innovation into clear, differentiated narratives that resonate with Dust’s buyers and users

  • Create launch assets across formats, including short-form videos, social campaigns, web copy, blogs, livestream events, customer communications, and sales collateral

  • Develop unique, scroll-stopping feature overview videos by owning storyboarding and screen capture end-to-end, while leveraging in-house creative and design support or external contractors as needed

  • Experiment with new formats and approaches to find the most effective ways to make Dust’s product understandable, memorable, and exciting

Become a trusted partner to product and engineering

  • Build strong relationships with engineers and user leads and become a partner they proactively bring into product launches

  • Develop enough technical fluency to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and uncover the most important customer and market story

  • Operate effectively in Dust’s highly autonomous product environment, where engineers often lead product initiatives directly

  • Bring customer, competitive, and market context into conversations about how we position and communicate the product

  • Partner with Dust’s founders and marketing leadership on major product narratives and moments

Connect product storytelling across the business

  • Equip Sales and Customer Success teams with the messaging, assets, and context they need to effectively pitch new capabilities to customers

Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role:

The Notion EMEA Recruiting team acts as trusted business partners who craft a thorough, inclusive, and curated interviewing experience. We believe hiring exceptional talent, at the right time, is the best path forward to achieve our company’s ambitious goals.

We’re looking for a Go-to-Market Recruiter to support our growth across key Go-to-Market (GTM) teams in EMEA, with an emphasis on Sales. In this role, you'll help shape our recruiting strategy, manage full-cycle hiring efforts, and ensure a delightful yet rigorous hiring process.

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Serve as a trusted recruiting partner to leaders across the GTM org, owning the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing through successful close

  • Design and implement creative sourcing strategies to attract diverse top talent across EMEA markets

  • Ensure scalable and structured hiring plans with consistent evaluation processes while creating thoughtful candidate experiences

  • Partner with cross-functional teams including Total Rewards, People Operations, and People Partners to drive holistic talent strategies

  • Leverage AI tools, to innovate recruiting processes and provide data-driven insights on market conditions

  • Champion and scale best practices while thoughtfully adapting for regional nuances

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in high-growth, technical, GTM functions

  • Fluency in French and English

  • Proven track record of identifying, qualifying, and closing exceptional talent across various levels

  • Experience coaching and advising hiring managers through our recruiting process while keeping talent density as a priority

  • Ability to build diverse candidate pipelines and guide hiring managers in creating inclusive teams

  • Outstanding communication, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills with a commitment to delivering high-quality recruiting experiences

  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments

Nice to Haves:

  • Passionate about leveraging technology and AI to transform recruiting processes

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The brand rests on a fine balance of medical rigor, premium design and a warm tone. Our products are built to last for years, not for a single product cycle.

Your body already knows. Withings helps you hear it.

Your Role

As Senior Graphic Designer, you will be the graphic backbone of our in-house creative studio. You will create, adapt, challenge and grow the Withings brand image, from product launches to brand guidelines, and imagine the visuals that bring our products to life around the world.

The studio is responsible for the graphic quality of every brand touchpoint, including product launches, communication and promotional campaigns, and high-impact projects for our markets in Europe, the United States and beyond, always to a premium standard. You will work alongside a motion designer and 3D artist and a graphic design apprentice to bring to life our premium universe, which we are reinventing for 2027.

We are looking for a true creative at heart: an experienced designer who loves and needs to imagine, experiment and make. This senior role includes a large share of hands-on production, as you will design and execute your own work from concept to final file. You bring new ideas, defend them and carry them through to execution, and you raise the brand's visual bar without waiting to be asked.

AI is already part of how the studio creates, with tools such as Krea, Nano Banana and Higgsfield, and its role keeps growing. You know how to use it to create more, faster, without compromising quality.

Art direction and creation

  • Imagine visual concepts and key visuals for product launches and campaigns.

  • Direct or support photo shoots and visual productions, from moodboards to selection and retouching.
  • Own your projects end to end, from understanding the brief and setting creative directions to execution and final files.

Exploration and ideas

  • Continuously explore new visual directions, formats and techniques, without waiting for a brief.
  • Propose innovative ideas for the brand and carry them through to production.
  • Challenge briefs from the marketing teams against their objectives before production begins.

Brand identity

AI and new tools

  • Build and share AI ways of working with the studio, including prompts, workflows, best practices and quality control.
  • Keep an eye on new tools and test them for the studio.

Production and collaboration

  • Adapt creations across formats and languages, down to the final production file, in line with the Brand Book.
  • Collaborate closely with the motion designer and 3D artist, and share your practices with the graphic design apprentice.
  • Brief and manage freelancers or vendors on selected projects.
  • Work with the Head of Creative and with marketing, product and communications teams in France and internationally.
  • Respect brand rules and health claims requirements in partnership with the legal and regulatory teams.
  • Manage your own priorities and deadlines.

Requirements

You have at least 4 years of experience in art direction or graphic design, gained in an agency, an in-house studio or a brand.

Must have

  • A real passion for creation: you need to imagine, experiment and make, and you want to stay at the heart of creative work rather than move toward project or budget management.
  • A portfolio that shows your ability to bring a brand to life across many touchpoints with flawless execution, along with your creative explorations, including personal projects.
  • Experience with premium or luxury brands in tech, beauty, lifestyle, design or health.
  • A strong graphic culture, with solid layout and composition skills.
  • Command of the Adobe suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma.

How you work

Benefits

  • Contributing to innovative, ambitious projects that are shaping the future of healthcare.

In this role, you will also have:

  • A small, close-knit team where your voice counts.
  • Room to explore new tools, AI and ways of working, where your ideas and experiments matter as much as production.

Intégrez le Département Hydrogéologie du Groupe Fondasol et mettez votre expertise au service de projets innovants alliant technique et développement durable. Pour accompagner notre équipe, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Hydrogéologue F/H pour renforcer notre équipe d'ingénieurs.
column2:
>

Vos missions au quotidien

En tant qu'Ingénieur Hydrogéologue, vous piloterez des projets d'aménagement et de gestion des eaux souterraines, de l'étude initiale à la présentation des résultats pour tous types de projets (espaces publics, bâtiments industriels, tertiaires, résidentiels, ouvrages souterrains, etc.). Vos missions consisteront à :

  • Elaborer des devis en tenant compte des besoins de votre client

  • Mener/piloter des campagnes de terrain pour l’acquisition des caractéristiques géologiques et hydrogéologiques de sites (essai de pompage, essai d’infiltration, traçages, prélèvements d’échantillons, etc.) en lien avec les Technicien Multi-Métiers.

  • Réaliser des études en lien avec les eaux souterraines pour des projets variés comme l’estimation des niveaux caractéristiques de nappe, le calcul des débits de pompage/épuisement en phase travaux, le suivi de travaux de rabattement, , les problématiques de gestion des eaux pluviales, les études géothermiques (aquathermie et champ de sondes), etc.

  • Concevoir des solutions techniques pour la gestion des eaux comme par exemple, des systèmes de rabattement de nappe, puits d’infiltration ou de recharge, bassins de rétention et ou infiltration d’eaux pluviales, ou encore des systèmes de drainage.

  • Rédiger des rapports techniques et présenter vos conclusions aux équipes de projets (MOA/MOE/AMO) et autorités (DREAL, DDT(M)).

  • Travailler en synergie avec les expertises du Groupe (géotechniques, environnementales, géophysiques, …) pour proposer des offres complètes et identifier de nouvelles opportunités.

  • Contribuez développement commercial en proposant l’ensemble de nos expertises et solutions innovantes en hydrogéologie, géothermie et stockage de déchets

column2:

In this responsible leadership role, you will manage a small team of fund operations specialists and ensure reliable, accurate and efficient processes across fund data, cost management, NAV controls and reporting. You will work closely with internal stakeholders as well as fund administrators, system providers, auditors, tax advisors and other external partners. As a member of the Valuation Committee, you will also contribute your expertise to fund valuation-related decisions.

The position offers a combination of team leadership, fund operations expertise, data management, regulatory knowledge and process automation, with considerable scope to improve existing processes and further professionalise the operational setup.
column4:

  • Review fund-related invoices and ensure transparency and accuracy of associated costs

  • Coordinate the preparation of factsheets, monthly fund manager reports and regular reporting for wholesale clients

  • Analyse existing processes and identify opportunities for greater efficiency, automation and data quality

  • Drive the use of automation and data-driven approaches to improve fund operations and reporting

  • Ensure that operational processes and reporting activities are aligned with applicable Swiss and Luxembourg regulatory requirements

  • Serve as a knowledgeable and reliable contact for internal stakeholders and external service providers across fund operations
column5:

About Rivia

Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.

Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.

Over the past two years, European- and US-based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.

Rivia's ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.

The Role

As our Clinical Solutions Consultant, you'll be the bridge between science, technology, and sales, helping biotech and pharma companies understand how Rivia can transform the way they work with clinical trial data.

You'll partner closely with our Account Executives throughout the technical stages of the sales cycle, turning complex scientific and technical challenges into compelling product demonstrations, tailored sandboxes, and solutions that address real customer needs.

This isn't a role where you simply present slides or follow a demo script. You'll need to understand clinical trial workflows, get hands-on with data, challenge assumptions, and translate complex customer requirements into solutions we can actually deliver.

You'll also play an important role in shaping how we approach technical pre-sales at Rivia, building repeatable processes, improving our demo environments, and helping us scale without losing the scientific depth and customer understanding that make us different.

What Excites You

  • Bringing science and technology together: You love understanding complex scientific challenges and translating them into practical, impactful solutions.

  • Being hands-on: You don't just talk about what a product can do. You enjoy building demos, configuring sandboxes, working with data, and showing customers what's possible.

  • Making an impact on revenue: You enjoy being part of the sales process, influencing strategic deals, and helping customers confidently make decisions.

  • Solving real customer problems: You're curious about how biotech and pharma companies operate and enjoy finding creative ways to address their challenges.

  • Building from the ground up: You get excited about joining a growing company where you can shape processes, improve tools, and help establish how technical pre-sales should work.

  • Working across teams: You enjoy collaborating with Sales, Product, and Engineering, balancing commercial opportunities with technical feasibility.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Executives as the scientific and technical expert throughout the sales process, helping prospects understand how Rivia can address their specific challenges.

  • Lead in-depth product demonstrations tailored to customers' clinical trial workflows, data structures, and scientific requirements.

  • Build and configure customized sandboxes, demo environments, and prototype integrations to demonstrate Rivia's value using realistic customer scenarios.

  • Understand customers' clinical trial pipelines, protocols, endpoints, and data challenges, translating their needs into practical technical solutions.

  • Scope prospective customer implementations, identifying technical requirements, dependencies, risks, and feasibility before commercial commitments are made.

  • Collaborate closely with Solutions Engineers and Customer Engagement to ensure smooth handovers from pre-sales to implementation.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to both customers and internal teams, confidently addressing complex scientific questions while being transparent about product capabilities and limitations.

  • Adapt demonstrations and technical conversations to customers' familiarity with and readiness to adopt AI-driven solutions.

  • Identify recurring customer needs, technical objections, and product gaps, sharing insights with Product and Engineering to continuously improve our offering.

  • Help develop scalable pre-sales processes, reusable demo environments, and technical documentation as Rivia grows.

What Excites Us

  • Scientific background: You have a degree in life sciences, bioinformatics, biomedical engineering, or a related scientific discipline, and you're comfortable navigating complex scientific discussions.

  • Relevant experience: You bring at least 4 years of client-facing experience in solutions consulting, technical pre-sales, field application science, technical account management, or similar roles.

  • Scientific and technical fluency: You understand scientific data and experimental logic, and can quickly grasp complex clinical trial workflows and technical requirements.

  • Hands-on technical skills: You've personally built and configured product demos, sandboxes, or technical proof-of-concepts, rather than only presenting solutions developed by others.

  • Commercial mindset: You understand how technical expertise contributes to winning deals and enjoy working closely with sales teams to move opportunities forward.

  • Customer-facing confidence: You can communicate complex technical concepts clearly and credibly, whether you're speaking with scientists, clinical operations leaders, or technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ownership: You're proactive, independent, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where processes are still being built.

  • Collaborative approach: You know when to challenge assumptions, push back on unrealistic commitments, and work across teams to deliver the best outcomes for customers.

Bonus / Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in scientific software, clinical trial technology, biotech platforms, or laboratory informatics.

  • Familiarity with clinical trial protocols, endpoints, regulatory considerations, and clinical data integration.

  • Experience working with AI-driven products or communicating the value of AI to scientific and technical stakeholders.

Our Values

  • In It to Win It: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive to achieve the best possible outcomes.

  • Embrace Change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead.

  • Why Not?: We challenge assumptions, stay curious, and explore new possibilities rather than accepting things as they are.

  • Find the Gap: We proactively identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and solve problems before they arise.

  • Collective Accountability: We're one team, on one mission, committed to shared responsibility, mutual support, and trust.

  • Value Add Solutions: Know better. Act better. We're dedicated to delivering meaningful solutions that create real impact.

📜 Contexte

Dans le cadre du renforcement de l'équipe Sécurité des Procédés d'un site industriel situé à Genève, Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés (H/F) afin de contribuer à la maîtrise des risques liés aux procédés chimiques et à la sécurité des opérations industrielles.

Rattaché(e) au Département HSE / Sécurité des Procédés, vous évoluerez dans un environnement industriel exigeant et apporterez un support technique aux équipes de Production, de Maintenance et d'Ingénierie.

Votre rôle sera axé sur la prévention des accidents majeurs, la conformité aux standards et réglementations applicables, ainsi que l'amélioration continue de la performance sécurité des procédés du site.

📌 Votre rôle

En tant qu'Ingénieur(e) Sécurité des Procédés, vous interviendrez comme expert(e) technique sur l'ensemble des sujets liés à la sécurité des procédés.

Vous contribuerez à l'identification, à l'évaluation et à la maîtrise des risques procédés sur les installations existantes, les modifications techniques et les nouveaux projets.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes EHS, Ingénierie, Production et Maintenance, ainsi qu'avec des interlocuteurs externes et les autorités locales lorsque nécessaire.

Vos missions

🎯 Responsabilités

🔹 Analyse des risques procédés
• Réaliser et mettre à jour les analyses de risques procédés, notamment les études HAZOP, What-If et LOPA.
• Identifier les scénarios de risques potentiels et recommander les mesures de prévention et de protection adaptées.
• Contribuer aux études de sécurité des installations existantes et des nouveaux projets.

🔹 Sécurité thermique & analyse technique
• Interpréter les résultats d'essais de sécurité thermique tels que DSC, C80 et RC1.
• Identifier des solutions concrètes pour maîtriser les risques liés aux réactions chimiques et aux procédés industriels.
• Analyser des données techniques complexes et formuler des recommandations claires.

🔹 Ingénierie & projets industriels
• Participer aux revues de conception des équipements et des installations industrielles.
• Contribuer aux projets d'investissement et aux modifications d'installations sous l'angle de la sécurité des procédés.
• Veiller à la prise en compte des exigences de sécurité tout au long de la conception.

🔹 Gestion du changement & conformité
• Participer aux processus de gestion du changement (MOC).
• Évaluer l'impact sécurité procédés des modifications techniques et vérifier leur conformité aux exigences applicables.
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre et le suivi des standards de sécurité des procédés conformément à la politique EHS de l'entreprise.

🔹 Support aux opérations & à la maintenance
• Apporter un support technique aux équipes d'exploitation et de maintenance sur les sujets de sécurité des procédés.
• Apporter votre expertise sur des thématiques telles que l'inertage, les pressions, les températures et les compatibilités chimiques.
• Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Audits, réglementation & études de sécurité
• Participer aux audits et inspections de conformité réglementaire.
• Contribuer aux analyses quantitatives des risques (QRA), aux études de protection contre les explosions et aux autres évaluations de sécurité.
• Veiller au respect des standards et réglementations applicables en matière de sécurité des procédés.

🔹 Formation & sensibilisation
• Former et sensibiliser le personnel aux principes et bonnes pratiques de sécurité des procédés.
• Promouvoir une culture forte de la sécurité des procédés sur le site.
• Communiquer les exigences réglementaires et techniques aux interlocuteurs concernés.

Vos compétences

💼 Votre profil

• Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master en génie chimique, chimie ou domaine équivalent.
• Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en sécurité des procédés dans un environnement industriel chimique ou pharmaceutique.
• Expérience confirmée dans la réalisation d'études de sécurité des procédés.
• Maîtrise des méthodologies HAZOP, LOPA, SIL et ATEX.
• Bonne connaissance des standards internationaux de sécurité des procédés tels que API, CCPS, IEC 61511 et SEVESO.
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des P&ID, schémas de procédé et spécifications d'équipements.
• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec l'aptitude à synthétiser des informations techniques complexes.
• Excellentes qualités de communication et capacités pédagogiques.
• Esprit d'équipe, proactivité et autonomie.
• Français courant et bon anglais technique, notamment pour la lecture et la rédaction de documents HSE internationaux.

Avantages

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.
column3:
margin-bottom:0px""> 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected
column4:
deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230
column6:
margin-bottom:0px""> 

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken
column8:
margin-bottom:0px""> 

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment

Wat ga je doen?

In een wereld waarin lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen steeds complexer worden, is het belangrijk om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de veiligheid en efficiëntie te garanderen. Binnen NLR werken we aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde aerospace systemen. We maken hierbij gebruik van software modelering en simulatie om het gedrag van complexe systemen te begrijpen en te optimaliseren.

Onze expertise in hardware testen en operationele ondersteuning (OPS) zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen theoretisch solide zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en robuust.

De belangstelling voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) neemt toe, met de noodzaak om onze lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen te beschermen tegen elektromagnetische bedreigingen. We zoeken hierom een teamleider binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electronic Warfare (ASEW)

Full-time Graduate Position / Part-time Working Student

📍 Utrecht, The Netherlands
🌍 International Sales & Marketing Team

Your market is DACH. Your team is international. Your career starts in Utrecht.

Are you a German-speaking student or recent graduate looking for an exciting start to your international career?

Would you like to work with colleagues from different countries, build business relationships, visit industry events and learn what professional B2B sales and partnership management are really about?

Welcome to Securance!

We are looking for an enthusiastic Junior International Sales & Partnership Representative to join our international Sales & Marketing team in Utrecht, the Netherlands.

Whether you're finishing your studies or have recently graduated, we offer you the opportunity to develop your commercial skills, build an international network and gain hands-on experience in business development.

One team. Many nationalities. Different markets.

Our sales team brings together colleagues from different countries and cultural backgrounds. Each team member focuses on developing business in their own home market, combining local knowledge and language skills with the strength of an international organization.

We work side by side in Utrecht, sharing experiences, exchanging ideas and supporting each other.

As our German-speaking representative, you'll focus on developing our business and partnerships across the DACH region.

You'll also work closely with our colleagues in Germany, travelling there regularly when needed to collaborate with the local team, meet partners, attend events and support commercial opportunities.

Your home base is Utrecht, but your professional network will extend across borders.

Learn Consultative Sales and Partnership Management from experienced professionals

At Securance, we believe successful business development starts with understanding people, their organizations and their challenges.

We don't focus on simply pushing products or closing quick deals. Instead, we practice Consultative Sales: asking the right questions, understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities and developing solutions that create long-term value.

You'll also learn how to build and manage strategic business partnerships, develop professional networks and turn relationships into meaningful commercial opportunities.

Our experienced and innovative team will coach you, involve you in real business activities and help you develop your own professional approach.

  • Partnership Management: Help build, develop and maintain relationships with business partners, referral partners and other relevant organizations.

  • Events & Networking: Attend industry conferences, networking events, trade fairs and business meetings to represent Securance and expand our professional network.

  • International Collaboration: Work closely with your international colleagues in Utrecht and regularly visit Germany to collaborate with the German team when needed.

  • Relationship Management: Support the development of long-term relationships with customers and partners.

  • Sales & Marketing: Contribute to commercial campaigns, market research, lead generation and international business development initiatives.

  • Market Development: Gradually take greater ownership of commercial activities and partnership opportunities in your market.

From day one, you'll be involved in real business activities, supported by experienced colleagues.

Who are we looking for?

We're looking for someone with potential, personality and a strong willingness to learn.

You:

  • Are in the final year of your studies or have recently graduated.

  • Speak German at native or near-native level and understand the German-speaking business environment.

  • Have good English communication skills, as English is our international working language.

  • Live in the Netherlands or are willing to relocate to the Utrecht area.

  • Enjoy meeting people, networking and building professional relationships.

  • Are curious, proactive, enthusiastic and commercially minded.

  • Enjoy working with colleagues from different nationalities and cultures.

  • Are interested in B2B sales, business development and partnership management.

  • Are comfortable attending business events and travelling to Germany regularly when required.

Previous sales experience is not required. Your attitude, motivation and willingness to learn matter much more.

A genuinely international workplace

Work alongside colleagues from different countries, each bringing their own perspectives, experience and market knowledge.

Excellent professional development

Receive practical training, personal coaching and guidance from experienced sales and business development professionals.

International exposure and travel

Visit Germany to collaborate with local colleagues, meet partners and customers, and attend relevant industry events.

Build your professional network

Develop relationships with companies, industry professionals and business partners across the DACH region.

Real responsibility

Contribute to developing your own market, commercial relationships and partnership opportunities.

An innovative professional environment

Learn about cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related professional services.

Opportunities for students and graduates

We welcome recent graduates interested in a full-time position and final-year students looking to combine their studies with meaningful part-time work.

A collaborative team culture

Become part of a team that shares knowledge, celebrates success and helps each other grow.

About Securance

Securance is an international professional services organization specializing in cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related advisory services.

We help organizations understand risks, strengthen controls and build confidence in their business and technology environments.

Our international approach combines professional expertise with local market understanding, strategic partnerships and long-term customer relationships.

As part of our commercial team, you'll learn how to translate complex business challenges into valuable conversations, business opportunities and sustainable partnerships.

Ready to start your international career?

If you're German-speaking, internationally minded and excited to develop your skills in sales, business development and partnership management, we'd love to meet you.

Join our international team in Utrecht. Build relationships across borders. Start your career with Securance.

Apply now!

👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol &
column2:
Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future

💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners &

Wie zoeken we?

We zijn op zoek naar een Eerste Lijns Service Engineer / Servicedesk Medewerker die klanten op een vriendelijke én deskundige manier verder helpt. Ben jij iemand die graag orde schept in de chaos?

Werk je graag met digitale systemen?
column3:

Dit is jouw uitdaging

We hebben honderden documenten met informatie over ons beleid en genomen besluiten. Deze documenten zijn relevant voor veel collega’s. Om die reden willen we de documenten graag op een overzichtelijke manier aanbieden, zodat alle collega’s snel en makkelijk het document kunnen vinden dat ze zoeken. We hebben al een idee hoe we dit willen gaan doen. Tijdens jouw stage ga je ons idee verder uitwerken en in de praktijk toepassen.

Dit zijn de concrete activiteiten:

  • Je gaat alle beleidsdocumenten verzamelen die nu nog op verschillende plekken zijn opgeslagen.

  • Je maakt een mappenstructuur aan, waarin de documenten op een logische plek komen te staan.

  • Je deelt de documenten in volgens de nieuwe structuur en voorziet ze van labels en metadata voor een optimale vindbaarheid.

  • Je controleert of documenten dubbel voorkomen en verwijdert dubbele, verouderde en niet meer relevante documenten.

  • Je kijkt of de nieuwe structuur in de praktijk goed werkt en of gebruikers de documenten gemakkelijk kunnen terugvinden.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten en doet waar nodig voorstellen voor verbeteringen.

We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar.

You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Ark builds platforms for public administrations. We entered the market about a year ago with our best-known tool, a platform for local climate action, and now work with more than 60 cities, counties and states, from Schleswig-Holstein, Munich and Berlin to small rural municipalities. We have won the German Startup Award 2026, raised €2.4 million in pre-seed and grant funding and are approaching €1 million in annual revenue.

As our Founders Associate Intern (all genders), you work side by side with our Chief of Staff Lennart, who is your day-to-day lead, and team up with our founder & CEO Ruth on selected projects. Your week has two halves. In the mornings you are part of our growth team and help win new public administrations as customers. This is the core of the role. In the afternoons you work with Lennart on whatever matters most for the company at that moment, from strategy and finance to HR and company initiatives.

You will see from the inside how a fast-growing GovTech startup wins customers, makes decisions and builds its team. If you are thinking about founding your own company one day, there are few better places to learn.

Tasks

Joining Ark as a Founders Associate Intern means a new mix of topics every week. Here is a range of potential challenges:

You learn how public sector sales work and see your impact in our pipeline every week. You'll receive a bonus for each qualified demo booked.

  • Strategy: Work with Lennart on strategic questions, prepare analyses and decision papers for management and turn decisions into concrete next steps.

  • People & HR: Support our recruiting from job posting to interview, help onboard new team members and contribute to initiatives that shape our team culture.

  • Finance: Help with financial planning, budgeting and reporting, for example when preparing updates for our investors.

Requirements

First Experience: Ideally first internships in a fast growing startup, consulting, VC or ops role. How quickly you learn matters more to us than your CV.

Drive in Sales: You enjoy talking to people, are not afraid of the phone and want to learn how to win customers. Half of your time is growth work, so this should excite you rather than be something you accept.

Structured Way of Working: You keep track of several topics at once and deliver reliably, even when priorities change during the day.

Analytical Mindset: You are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets and can turn complex information into a clear recommendation.

Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication to engage with municipalities, partners and our team.

Entrepreneurial Spirit: You thrive in a fast-paced startup setting and see limited resources as a chance to innovate. You are hands-on, proactive and a natural problem-solver.

full-stack-engineer-data-infrastructure-ai-berlin-440195,Agent F GmbH,"Full-Stack Engineer - Data, Infrastructure & AI","

About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. These founding roles will shape both the product and the way we build it.

About the role

You will be a full-stack engineer, shipping customer features across the interface, application services and database. Your particular strength will be the data and infrastructure that make those features dependable: how records are stored, how imports and background jobs run, and how information moves between Agent F and a customer’s other tools. You will help build and operate the whole product, with deeper ownership of this foundation.

This is hands-on full-stack engineering. A typical piece of work could involve extending a data model, implementing an application service, connecting it to a screen, testing it against a real database and following the release into production. You will also investigate slow reports, failed imports and jobs that stop halfway through, then improve the system so it handles those situations reliably.

That foundation also supports our AI work. As we add document extraction, connected customer knowledge and software that takes actions for customers, you will build the services and data access those features need. The immediate priority is dependable software that customers can use, with more capable automation developed around specific tasks.

What you will build and improve

  • Application services and customer features. Build the logic and application programming interfaces (APIs) that connect records, business rules and screens. Take features through implementation, testing, release and production support.

  • The database foundation. Design clear data models, enforce relationships and transaction boundaries, and improve slow queries. Manage schema changes through reviewed migrations, preserve financial history and keep each customer’s data isolated.

  • Imports and integrations. Connect accounting tools, business systems and spreadsheets to a consistent model. Validate incoming records, handle changing source formats, and check that imported totals and reports agree with the source.

  • Reliable background processing. Build scheduled jobs and workers that process work outside a user request. Handle retries without creating duplicates, resume interrupted runs, and make progress and failures visible to the team.

  • Performance and recovery. Diagnose expensive queries, processing bottlenecks and partial failures. Test changes against real databases, plan for growing workloads, and build procedures to recover processing safely with the platform engineer.

  • Practical AI automation. Add features such as extracting invoice fields or preparing an order from approved business data. Give models access through controlled services, check the result and require approval where needed. Develop connected customer knowledge when a feature needs those relationships, and measure whether it improves the result.

For example, a large customer import stops halfway through and the same records arrive again on the next run. You would make processing resume safely, prevent duplicate records, verify the resulting totals and expose the job’s status in the product. You would also investigate whether database queries or worker capacity caused the failure and ship the necessary fix.

What you bring

You have seven or more years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production applications and data systems. You have designed relational data models, built services and processing pipelines, and stayed responsible for them after release. You are comfortable delivering across the stack and using AI tools in your daily work.

You can explain how you diagnosed a slow query, recovered a failed job or shipped a database change safely. You understand what happens when two requests arrive at once, a dependency becomes unavailable or a process restarts halfway through its work. You can follow a problem from a source record through the application to the result a customer sees.

Core experience

  • Full-stack development with TypeScript, Node.js, React and PostgreSQL, or closely comparable technologies.

  • Relational data modelling, SQL, query optimisation, indexes, transactions and reviewed database migrations.

  • Application services and APIs, including permissions, validation and handling concurrent requests.

  • Data imports, integrations and background jobs, including queues, safe retries and recovery from partial failures.

  • Production debugging, service monitoring and performance work on systems used by real customers.

  • Automated tests against real databases and other service dependencies.

  • Practical use of AI in software, with an understanding of how to check outputs and control access to customer data.

  • Daily use of AI coding agents, with direct responsibility for code review and verification.

  • A computer science or computer engineering degree, or equivalent practical depth.

Useful additional experience

Financial or operational systems where correctness and traceability matter

In your first months, you would take ownership of an existing service or data flow, understand how it runs in production and ship a customer-facing improvement through it. A founder looking at their finances for the first time and a controller investigating a discrepancy need different levels of detail. This combines product design with hands-on front-end engineering. You will talk to customers, shape the journey, design the interactions and ship them in the product. You will use AI coding agents to help implement changes, and take responsibility for reviewing the code and checking the finished experience.

Your work will connect the product into a coherent whole: consistent navigation, familiar controls and clear explanations across features. You will also own the steps that turn an interested visitor into an active, paying customer.
